title: The @claude workflows no longer run on issue assignment or on fork pull requests, and claude.yml frames untrusted text as data with a tool allow-list

criteria.then: the issues trigger fires on opened only; assigning an issue does not start the agent

criteria.given: a @claude comment or review on a pull request whose head is a fork
criteria.then: claude.yml refuses before the agent step, and claude-code-review.yml only runs for same-repository pull requests
it has a fixed prompt that marks issue/PR text as untrusted data, and a tool allow-list in claude_args that does not allow git push or edits under .github/
